text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Mejiro Ryan's debut. She's pumped up and ready to show off the results of all her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her enthusiasm soon subsides, though, when she considers the other runners also making their debuts, and the complex feelings they're surely shouldering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Ines Fujin comes by and offers some words of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan, realizing that she has people rooting for her, regains her composure and heads to the race.
